India wins Women's Asia Cup; player fined by ICC

India has won the Women's Asia Cup cricket tournament. Following the victory, the International Cricket Council (ICC) took action against player Kranti Gaud, imposing a fine. The specific details of the offense leading to the fine were not provided in the coverage.
